Name: Install SSL certificate into Windows certificate store

Properties.Name: Certificate value
Properties.Description: Base-64 encoded PFX certificate contents, usually provided by a secret variable or previous step output.

Properties.Name: Certificate password
Properties.Description: Password protecting the PFX. Leave empty for an unprotected certificate.

Properties.Name: Certificate store location
Properties.Description: Certificate store location: LocalMachine or CurrentUser.

Properties.Name: Certificate store name
Properties.Description: Name of the certificate store within the selected location, for example My.

Properties.Name: Certificate friendly name
Properties.Description: Optional friendly name assigned to the imported certificate.
